name: @commandrelay/tui
description: Cross-platform terminal UI client for CommandRelay

scripts.build: pnpm exec node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm exec node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const flattenSource='dist/commandrelay-tui/src';if(fs.existsSync(flattenSource)){const walk=(root)=>{for(const entry of fs.readdirSync(root,{withFileTypes:true})){const src=path.join(root,entry.name);if(entry.isDirectory()){walk(src);}else if(src.endsWith('.js')||src.endsWith('.d.ts')||src.endsWith('.map')){const target=path.join('dist',path.basename(src));if(src!==target){fs.copyFileSync(src,target);}}}};walk(flattenSource);}const candidates=['dist/cli.js','dist/commandrelay-tui/src/cli.js'];let target='';for(const candidate of candidates){if(fs.existsSync(candidate)){target=candidate;break;}}if(!target){throw new Error('cli.js not found in expected output paths');}if(target!=='dist/cli.js'){fs.copyFileSync(target,'dist/cli.js');}fs.chmodSync('dist/cli.js',0o755);"
